priorRuntimeBuildDifference: The release shortens the English Water tree label to Water. The resource ID and Android runtime code match.

languageSwitching.details: Switched Vietnamese to English and English to Vietnamese in Settings. Route and saved balance persisted.

defaultPlantNames.details: Vietnamese-created cherry showed Spring cherry in English. English-created lavender showed Oải hương tím in Vietnamese.

customNicknames.details: Sunny remained Sunny in both languages.

wateringAlignment.details: Water and Watered fit on one line. Watered was disabled with top and bottom edges matching Decorate. The Vietnamese state also aligned.

heldPress.details: Actual touchscreen down/up on Decorate showed scaled content without a rectangular overlay and opened the tree view on release.

localeRestart.details: Vietnamese persisted through a force-stop and relaunch.

mainTreeIconSwitching.details: Cherry, lavender and mandarin resolved to their own launcher aliases. MainActivity stayed open and the process survived the palette changes.

launcherRestart.details: Relaunching the lavender alias restored the selected lavender tree.

notificationNavigationAndFocus.details: Tree, timer task and non-timer task destinations opened from notification intents. The focus timer counted down and paused.

captures.description: Vietnamese and lavender retained after process restart
English selection applied while keeping the Settings screen
Single-line Water action next to Decorate
Disabled Watered action aligned with Decorate
Held Decorate press without a rectangular overlay
Vietnamese watered state and localized lavender default
Orange HabiTree icon in Pixel Launcher
